conviction_note: The print is binary and large: audited FY25/26 accounts plus the final conclusions of the independent investigation into the Grizzly short report, which the company has promised by these results at the latest. Because of that I put abs_move at 13. The only directional evidence is soft. EBITDA is very likely below the company's own >EUR36m guide: H1 ran at a 4.7% margin, 94% of sales are hardware, and the July revenue release went quiet on EBITDA. The EUR1bn FY26/27 ambition was hedged on 12 Oct. Against those, the investigation is company-commissioned and its first conclusions were clean (+9.2% the next session). So p_up is 45. The findings sum to -4.5 against a scaled -1.3; the gap is the investigation tail, which is wide in both directions and is carried by abs_move, not by the sum.

new_in_release.expect: FY25/26 EBITDA, operating and net result, the first figures since the March H1. Expected BELOW the >EUR36m guide, plausibly EUR20-28m, given H1 at 4.7% margin and a hardware-heavy H2. Negative.

Final conclusions of the independent investigation: three fiscal years, the USD610m contract risks, 21 third parties named by Grizzly, related-party identification. Promised by these results at the latest. Direction unknown. Company-commissioned and framed as 'constats factuels'; the first instalment was clean. Two-sided tail.
The auditor's report in the annual financial report, the first audited accounts since the short report. An unqualified opinion is the base case. No postponement notice was found as of 28 Oct.

FY26/27 EUR1bn ambition: reiteration likely, but at risk of softening given the 12 Oct delay caveat and its dependence on a CEO-owned vehicle and on a NYGC order not yet invoiced. Slight negative skew.
Q1 FY26/27 activity and whether the ~USD290m California order (due 'summer 2026') has shipped: unknown, and decisive for the Grizzly narrative.
Year-end cash EUR14.4m is already public; working capital and receivables are unknown.

bar: The company's own FY25/26 guide: revenue that could exceed EUR400m (met at 416.2) and EBITDA above EUR36m, in the H1 release of 26 Mar 2026, https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/EQS/2026/03/FCEQS008141_20260326.pdf. No sell-side EBITDA consensus could be sourced (Portzamparc's buy rating and EUR63.8 target are public, its estimate is not), so the company guide is the bar.
session_check: amc, from the issuer's own pattern, not from this release's timestamp. The 29 Oct 2026 date is on the issuer's calendar (https://investors.2crsi.com/en/financial-calendar, 'Thursday, October 29, 2026 Full-Year Results and Annual Financial Report 2025/2026') and in the 23 Jul release. Both prior results releases went out after the Paris close: FY24/25 results at 2025-10-30T18:33Z (19:33 CET; https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/EQS/2025/10/FCEQS007713_20251030.pdf, Euronext stamp 19:32 CET), and the stock fell 23.8% the next session. H1 results at 2026-03-26T18:10Z (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/EQS/2026/03/FCEQS008141_20260326.pdf), and the stock rose 10.1% the next session. Only the revenue releases go out pre-market. Likely window: close(2026-10-29) to close(2026-10-30).
positioning_check: AMF register read on 2026-10-26 (covered: true). It shows no disclosed net short position at or above 0.5% and no change over ten days. anchor_covered is false, so this is the truncation floor and not proof that nobody is short. Grizzly Research's own position, if it holds one, is not disclosed above the threshold. No positioning anchor, and priced_lean_pct (+0.1) is essentially the run-up.

findings.finding: FY25/26 EBITDA is likely to land well below the company's own 'EBITDA superieur a 36 M EUR' guide. Hitting it needs H2 EBITDA of EUR26.4m+ on H2 revenue of about EUR211.5m (a 12.5% margin), against 4.7% in H1 (EUR9.6m on EUR204.7m), equipment at about 94% of sales, and a July revenue release that confirmed the revenue beat but said nothing on EBITDA.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY24/25 results (EBITDA EUR5.6m after an exceptional customer discount, against a 12% margin ambition): -23.8% the next session (31 Oct 2025). H1 FY25/26 (EBITDA EUR9.6m 'conforme aux attentes', guide raised): +10.1% (27 Mar 2026).
findings.original_quote: 2CRSi se fixe pour objectif d'atteindre un niveau d'activite pouvant depasser 400 M EUR sur l'exercice, ainsi qu'un EBITDA superieur a 36 M EUR, en fonction du rythme de deploiement des projets. (Translation: 2CRSi targets revenue that could exceed EUR400m for the year and EBITDA above EUR36m, depending on the pace of project deployment.) And from 23 Jul 2026: 'l'appreciation des marges constituera aussi une priorite' (margin improvement will also be a priority), with no EBITDA figure reaffirmed.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has been set by the Grizzly fraud question since 18 Jun (-43% that day), not by margins, and no sell-side EBITDA estimate is published. If the shortfall were priced, the July release's silence on EBITDA would have drawn a reaction; the stock moved -1.1% that day and +4.1% the next. This is inference from H1 margin and mix, not a number from a document, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The Jan 2026 promise to beat the EBITDA-margin target followed by a 4.7% H1 margin (https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/2crsi-vise-desormais-un-depassement-de-ses-objectifs-pour-l-exercice-2025-2026_687336) points the same way: this management overstates margin. The same document-family caveat applies.

findings.finding: The release must carry the independent investigator's conclusions on the remaining Grizzly allegations. The scope covers three fiscal years, the USD610m contract's dependence, non-materialisation and counterparty risk, the 21 named third parties and their beneficial owners, and related-party identification. The first, single-contract instalment came back clean.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Grizzly report: -43% (18 Jun 2026), then -13.4% on resumption. First investigator conclusions released after the close on 15 Sep: +9.2% the next session (16 Sep 2026).
findings.original_quote: La Societe rendra compte des travaux relatifs aux autres points souleves par le rapport Grizzly au plus tard lors de la publication de ses resultats annuels. (Translation: the Company will report on the work on the other points raised by the Grizzly report at the latest when it publishes its annual results.)
findings.why_not_priced: The conclusions are not public; the 3 Aug release said the final report was due in October and nothing has been filed since. The stock sits at EUR27.6, about 40% below its pre-report EUR44.6, so neither a clean bill (squeeze toward pre-report) nor a damaging related-party finding is in the price. Sized near zero because the sign is genuinely open. The company commissions and frames the work, which leans positive, but the scope explicitly hunts for related parties, and the 5 Aug filing already shows the CEO's holding owns AETHER.
findings.independence: Scope and timetable in the 3 Aug release: https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/EQS/2026/08/FCEQS008616_20260803.pdf (same issuer). AETHER ownership in the 5 Aug release: https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/EQS/2026/08/FCEQS008628_20260805.pdf.

findings.finding: The EUR1bn FY26/27 revenue ambition rests increasingly on AETHER, a vehicle 100% owned by the CEO's holding (Holding Alain Wilmouth), and on a NYGC order that had produced no revenue by 30 June. The company's own 12 Oct release pre-hedged it: permit or component delays could push deliveries past the June 2027 year-end. That makes a softened or caveated guide at the results more likely than a raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 12 Oct AETHER release (EUR1bn+ potential): +17.7% that day, fully given back over the next two weeks (EUR29.18 to EUR27.58). Guide raises at H1: +10.1%.
findings.original_quote: Ces perspectives sont presentees sous les reserves d'usage : un retard dans l'obtention des permis ou dans la disponibilite des composants pourrait reporter tout ou partie des livraisons au-dela de la cloture de l'exercice fiscal en cours de 2CRSi, fixee a fin juin 2027. (Translation: these prospects are subject to the usual reservations: a delay in obtaining permits or in component availability could push all or part of the deliveries beyond the close of 2CRSi's current fiscal year, end of June 2027.) And 5 Aug: 'AETHER Infrastructures ... dont la presidence est assuree par Holding Alain Wilmouth (HAW), qui en est actuellement l'actionnaire unique.' (AETHER Infrastructures is chaired by Holding Alain Wilmouth, currently its sole shareholder.)
findings.why_not_priced: The market rallied 17.7% on the EUR1bn+ headline and has drifted back, so it does not treat the guide as a coin flip. The delay caveat and the related-party ownership sit in the French regulated filings, not the wire headlines (ABC Bourse covered the potential, not the caveat). Already public, so sized modestly. It lands on the guidance line, where moves on this name are largest.
findings.independence: The H1 release flagged DRAM/NAND/processor shortages that could shift execution cycles (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/EQS/2026/03/FCEQS008141_20260326.pdf). The 23 Jul release confirms the USD610m framework produced no FY25/26 revenue (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/EQS/2026/07/FCEQS008561_20260723.pdf).

baseline_tension: The lean (+0.1) and run-up (-2% over 20 days, flat over 60) carry no information here. My findings lean mildly negative on the reported year and the guide. The dominant item, the investigation's conclusions, has no sourced sign, so p_up sits only slightly below 50 while abs_move is large.
language_note: The original French text of the 15 Sep investigator release. It contains the commitment to report on the remaining Grizzly points 'au plus tard lors de la publication de ses resultats annuels', which makes the investigation part of this print.
The H1 release's explicit 'EBITDA superieur a 36 M EUR' guide. ABC Bourse's January summary only spoke of beating the margin targets.
The 12 Oct release's caveat that deliveries could slip past June 2027. The wire summary (ABC Bourse) carried the EUR1bn+ potential without it.
The 5 Aug AMF-prompted clarification that AETHER Infrastructures is 100% owned by the CEO's holding.
The issuer's own AMF timestamps establishing that results go out after the close (18:10Z and 18:33Z).
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide': the guidance finding (EUR1bn FY26/27) was moved from -2.0 to -2.5 and sized on the guidance scale. abs_move kept at 13, above the 9% guidance-change base, because of the investigation tail and 91% realised vol.
'Your own session check ... open with the verdict': session_check now opens with amc and cites the issuer's prior results timestamps.
'A finding about a number already told is worth 0': checked. Revenue and cash are pre-released and excluded; EBITDA was never pre-released, so finding 1 stays at -3.0.
